MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing felt like a natural next purchase because it helps insulate wire connections in projects involving my battery holder, relay, and circuit boards.",
    "The electronic cleaner connects with my electrical projects through a practical maintenance need, although I would check that it is suitable for the parts I want to clean."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The three filament choices assume I use a 3D printer; buying electronics components does not establish that I own one or need any particular filament material.",
    "The feeler gauge, cutting wheels, and locking nuts require specific tasks or compatible equipment that my purchases do not establish.",
    "Glue could help with small assemblies, but twelve tubes exceeds my immediate need; a thousand small gloves also requires a recurring use and confirmed fit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "My component and caster purchases seem to have been taken as evidence of broader fabrication needs, even though they do not establish a printing or metal-cutting project."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The clearest connection across my electronics purchases is assembling and connecting small electrical parts, which makes supplies for insulating and maintaining those connections especially relevant.",
    "I need a concrete use for an item now, and equipment compatibility, dimensions, and pack quantity can outweigh a general connection to DIY work."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my electronics interests but extended them too broadly into workshop supplies without enough evidence of a current need."
}
